basis: Human disease is predominantly rhinosporidiosis; persistent nasal/nasopharyngeal lesions affect about 70-90%, directly occupying upper airways.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: human Ichthyosporea disease is predominantly rhinosporidiosis, with nasal/nasopharyngeal lesions in about 70-90%.

basis: Age-defined cancer umbrella has no shared organ of origin; selecting blood, CNS or bone would extrapolate from distinct subtypes.

decisions.haematologic: none: leukemia and other blood malignancies are subtypes; a blood origin does not characterize most cancers across this umbrella.
decisions.neurologic: none: CNS tumors are a subset, not a shared defining site across childhood malignancies.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: bone and soft-tissue sarcomas are subtypes, not a shared organ of origin across this umbrella.

basis: Dysostosis and severe ID define syndrome; cleft palate and eyelid coloboma/ptosis each 80-99%. Nail/skin defects omitted by cap; genitourinary anomalies 5-29%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: cleft palate causes direct oral structural dysfunction in 80-99%; associated craniofacial manifestation rather than the defining dysostosis/ID axes.

basis: Defining fracture-prone osteopenia, severe myopia and sensorineural hearing loss; ID in both reported brothers (2/2). Enamel hypoplasia omitted by four-axis cap.

decisions.neurologic: involved: intellectual disability is defining and present in both brothers (2/2); placed here because primary is capped at three.
decisions.otologic: primary: sensorineural hearing loss is a named defining feature in both brothers, alongside osteopenia and severe myopia.

basis: ID, muscle wasting, kyphosis and joint hyperextensibility define syndrome; amyotrophy 7/12. Obesity and small testes alone do not establish direct endocrine dysfunction.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: obesity (15/19) and small testes (10/15) do not establish endocrine gland dysfunction or an intrinsic metabolic disorder.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: muscle wasting, kyphosis and joint hyperextensibility are explicit defining features; distal amyotrophy occurs in 7/12.

basis: Reticulate pigment disorder with explicit fucoglycosan-synthesis disorder ancestry; inherited glycosylation defect supports the metabolic mechanism axis.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: explicit fucoglycosan-synthesis disorder ancestry identifies an inborn glycosylation disorder; systemic endocrine damage is not required for this mechanism axis.

basis: Combined open cranial/spinal neural tube malformation includes defining cranial and vertebral nonclosure; cervical spina bifida occurs in 80-99%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: cranial and vertebral nonclosure are intrinsic to craniorachischisis; cervical spina bifida is annotated in 80-99%.

basis: Sterol defect defined by liver disease and developmental delay; cataracts 2/2 and corneal opacity 30-79% support ocular damage. Frequent skeletal/renal anomalies omitted by cap.

decisions.hepatic: primary: liver disease is explicit in the definition; hepatic fibrosis reported in 1/1 and intrahepatic cholestasis in 30-79%.
decisions.neurologic: primary: developmental delay is explicit in the definition and annotated 80-99%; cerebellar cortical atrophy occurs in 30-79%.

basis: Anomalous pulmonary artery origin defines defect; direct tracheobronchial compression with airway obstruction occurs in roughly half or more, independent of intrinsic tracheal stenosis.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: the anomalous artery directly compresses the tracheobronchial airway, causing functional obstruction in roughly half or more; intrinsic tracheal stenosis is not required.

basis: Gastric intrinsic-factor secretory deficiency causes B12 malabsorption and megaloblastic anemia; dementia/learning disability 30-79% supports neurologic involvement.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: congenital loss of gastric intrinsic-factor function directly defines B12 malabsorption; gastric mucosal atrophy is not required for a secretory functional defect.
